artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten-style text on the green area appears nonsensical and malformed, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than legible handwriting.
The halftone dot pattern is visually distinct but appears slightly irregular and 'mushy' in transition areas, lacking the crisp geometric precision of a real printed halftone screen.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge where rings meet paper
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection between the metal rings and the paper holes is somewhat ambiguous; some rings appear to merge slightly with the paper edges rather than passing cleanly through holes.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object class is indeed a binder and not a similar office supply like a file folder or ledger.
To verify the physical separation between the metal rings and the paper, ensuring no fusion artifacts exist at the interaction points.
To analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the text elements, which are prone to AI generation errors.
To assess the realism of the printed halftone pattern and detect any subtle texture inconsistencies or blurring.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on the green tab
Physical integrity of the ring-to-paper connection points
Geometric regularity of the halftone dot pattern
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the green tab; if it is illegible gibberish, this is a strong artifact signal. Also, verify if the halftone pattern maintains consistent dot spacing and shape, as AI often distorts regular geometric patterns. Check if the rings physically intersect the paper holes correctly or if they appear fused.
